entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Agent' at any time to speak with a representative.
Agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, this is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for two items from my last order.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF90210. It was for a jersey and one of those VeloBand Pulse trackers.
Perfect, I have the order right here. Let's see... one Aero-Pro jersey and one VeloBand Pulse. I see it was delivered about twelve days ago. Let's process this for you.
Okay, the jersey is no problem at all. It's well within our 90-day return window, so I've just emailed you a prepaid return label for that.
Great, thank you. And for the Pulse?
Ah, regarding the VeloBand Pulse... I'm afraid I can't accept that return. It looks like it is outside of its specific return window.
What? That's ridiculous. I just got it! How can one item be fine to return and the other isn't? They came in the same box!

I completely understand your confusion, and I'm sorry for the frustration. We have separate policies for electronics versus apparel. The jersey has a 90-day window, but the Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy due to its electronic components. Since your order was delivered 12 days ago, it's unfortunately ineligible.
Separate policies? That's insane. I'm a VIP member, I order from you all the time. I can't believe you won't take back these two items together. This is terrible service.

I can see you're a valued VIP member, and we absolutely don't want you to be unhappy. While the policy on returning the actual Pulse is something I can't override, I do want to find a way to make this right for you.
And how are you going to do that?
Since this policy wasn't clear and caused this inconvenience, I can issue a $50 VeloFit store credit to your account right now. You could use it toward a future purchase, no exclusions.
Fifty dollars? Hmm. Well, I'm still not happy about being stuck with the tracker, but... I do appreciate you doing something. That's a reasonable compromise, I suppose.

I'm glad we could find a solution. I've just applied the $50 credit to your account, and it's available immediately. You should have also received the return label for the jersey. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you for sorting this out, Alex. I really appreciate you taking care of it.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for being a VeloFit VIP, and have a great day!
